clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, the Hallowed Sigil summons young night elf initiates to Aldrassil. Shanda sends it to call them into service to Elune.

Young night elf priests in Shadowglen receive the Hallowed Sigil from a woodland messenger. Holy markings are engraved on the token, which carries a personal summons from Shanda, the priest trainer at Aldrassil. Read it, then go up to the great hollow of Aldrassil. There, the summons brings the acolyte to the Sisterhood of Elune and begins their service to the Kaldorei as new travelers arrive across Teldrassil.
